# Credits {.unnumbered}

The ten-week core (Chapters 1 through 10) was constructed
by surveying publicly available clinical-trials syllabi
from graduate biostatistics departments, including the
courses at Yale, Minnesota, Wisconsin, UCSF, Duke, and the
University at Buffalo, and adopting the topics common to
most of them: the justification for randomized experiments,
protocol and endpoint development, randomization methods,
blinding and placebos, sample size determination,
non-inferiority, early-phase designs, the primary analysis
of parallel-group trials, interim monitoring, adaptive
designs, missing data, and reporting.

The advanced-topic chapters (11 through 28) derive from the
author's methodological research compendia. Each such
chapter names its source compendium in a Provenance
section.

Cover artwork generated procedurally by the Python script
at `images/build-cover.py`. Watercolor palette: deep
oxblood through clay and terracotta to warm sand, anchored
on a brand oxblood `#7a3b52`. Typography: Avenir family
(Apple system font); body text in Source Serif 4.
